name: Lacustrine-Tombolo
description: This is a world of broad skies and long sightlines, its map written in ancient meteor crater. Travelers navigate by massive canyon systems and by nothing else, because nothing else stands still.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
Geologists argue about the strata here: several layers appear deposited out of order, as if the planet's history were shuffled like cards.
There is money in iron and medicinal compounds and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
